verdict.rationale: First-party docs list several install paths: an installer script, npm/pnpm/bun, Docker, and desktop app downloads. They also promise you can install, run onboarding, and chat with the assistant in about 5 minutes, using a Gateway process on your own machine that serves a browser Control UI. Missing for 10: the literal one-line install command is not quoted in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration that a fresh install reaches a working chat within minutes.
